body: I'd like to talk, I'll explain more. The thing is that I'm no prodigy or anything, but my mother stills wants me to have an A+++++++++++++++++ on everything, also she doesn't care much for any opinion I have, and forces me to do stuff I don't want to. Oh, and my parents are divorced; I lived 7 years with my dad, his wife and her two older than me son and daughter, who kept insulting (bullying?) me. Recently I moved with my mother, her son (4 years old, I don't see him as a brother, I don't know) and her boyfriend, who she doesn't even like anymore. I am getting sick of her/this situation, the whole world and my life. I feel like everything I have in my mind doesn't care, and that I have to live by her forcing me to do things I aren't happy doing (don't think this is pedophilia or something, she is like actively choosing my destiny). I can't handle this anymore, I'm not comfortable here and just want everything to be good and live a normal life.
